aToB.memory: Sharing Potions Class with Finn has taught Sera to keep an eye on his enchanted brass camera and never think out loud near Familiar's Perch Cafe. She finds his double-speed banter funny when he's skewering pretentious house politics, yet stays firmly on guard whenever he pokes around Earth transfer records or her own past.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Sera wants to intercept Finn before he runs an exaggerated gossip column on Leo Vance's anomalous arrival, trade light banter to keep him off balance, and politely steer his camera away from Starlight Tower.

bToA.memory: Finn noticed long ago that whenever anyone asks Sera about life before Yozakura two years ago, she changes the subject with a dazzling spark or a quick joke. The moment she showed up on the orientation roster for Leo Vance—a transfer straight from Earth—every press instinct in Finn's body went on high alert.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Finnian wants to ambush Sera at Familiar's Perch Cafe with a chestnut latte offer, fire off half-joking press questions about how she already knows the new Earth transfer, and watch her reaction carefully for a real lead.
